_comment: Pinned by an independent decimal computation (not by the code under test); `ledgerCases` (loan ledger walk and plan ahead, spec B2/B3 of 2026-10-13-history-from-dated-facts-design.md) the same way. Read by services/loan_amortization.rs and shared/calculations/loan-amortization.test.ts; both must reproduce every value to the cent. Regenerate only after changing the documented rules.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-estimated-only
ledgerCases.note: No events: the legacy annuity from the start. Before the start the balance is 0.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-manual-record-holds
ledgerCases.note: A manual record replaces the estimate and holds for months; the plan ahead restarts from it, payments on the 15th.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-manual-plan-on-a-due-day
ledgerCases.note: Today is a payment day of the segment cycle: the manual balance already includes it, so the first planned payment is a month later.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-extra-payment-estimated
ledgerCases.note: Estimated mode: payments through the event day, minus the extra payment; the event day becomes the anchor (payments move to the 20th).

ledgerCases.name: ledger-extra-payment-estimated-lower-payment
ledgerCases.note: Legacy row (no previous payment recorded): the loan row already holds the lowered payment (1500), so the estimated path before the event uses it too; the new payment applies from the event day.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-extra-payment-manual
ledgerCases.note: Manual mode (D7): the extra payment gives a new manual value, manual minus payment, and the mode stays manual; a lowered payment changes only the plan. The loan row holds the lowered payment (1800) and the event records the one it replaced (2000), as the service writes them.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-rate-change-estimated
ledgerCases.note: Estimated mode: before the change the previous terms apply; the event day becomes the anchor and the new terms apply from it.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-rate-change-manual
ledgerCases.note: Manual mode: the balance is unchanged by a rate change; only the plan ahead uses the new terms.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-two-manual-records
ledgerCases.note: The first manual record holds until the second one's day, which then holds.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-two-manual-records-second-deleted
ledgerCases.note: Deleting the second record restores the first: it holds again after the second's old day.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-same-day-order-by-created-at
ledgerCases.note: Events on one day apply in created order whatever the array order: record first, then the extra payment.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-before-start-is-zero
ledgerCases.note: Before the start day the balance is 0 (history and today); the plan of a loan that has not started continues from its start.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-legacy-rate-change-without-previous
ledgerCases.note: A legacy rate change has no previous terms: the estimated path before it uses the loan's current terms (as before).

ledgerCases.name: ledger-manual-then-estimated-event-order
ledgerCases.note: A rate change before a manual record re-anchors the estimate; the later record then holds over it.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-extra-payment-clamps-at-zero
ledgerCases.note: An extra payment above the balance clears it; the balance never goes negative and stays 0.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-extra-payment-lower-payment-previous-recorded
ledgerCases.note: The loan row already holds the lowered payment (1500), as the service writes it; the extra payment records the payment it replaced (2000), so the walk before it uses 2000.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-initial-terms-from-the-earliest-carrier-per-field
ledgerCases.note: Each initial term comes from the earliest event that carries it, whatever its kind: the extra payment gives the first payment (2000), the rate change the first rate (6 %); the rate change's own previous payment (1700) is not an initial term.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-last-segment-uses-the-loan-columns
ledgerCases.note: The loan form edited the rate and payment after a rate change (4.5 % / 1 900 became 5.5 % / 1 950 on the loan). Segments before the last rate or payment event keep the terms their events carry (6 % / 2 000 up to the change); the last segment, from the change on, runs on the loan's current columns.

ledgerCases.name: ledger-manual-plan-uses-the-loan-columns
ledgerCases.note: A manual record after the rate change: the balance holds, and the plan ahead runs on the loan's current columns (5.5 % / 1 950 after a form edit), not on the 4.5 % / 1 900 the event carries.
